title: arewehuman project settings
description: Settings for a project whose recordings are kept in this .arewehuman directory. Commit this file with the project, so that everyone working on it uses the same settings.

autoRecord.description: Glob patterns of files to record whenever they are opened in VS Code, starting a recording if they have none (the recording file is created at the first save). Patterns are relative to the project root; a pattern without a slash matches the file name in any folder.
